expectations.text: The guide names the receiving location and enters 6000 grams and $0.012 per gram, with cost per stock unit distinguished from total sack cost.
expectations.evidence: Names Items > select item > Receive existing stock and specifies Quantity: 6000 and Cost (per stock unit): $0.012; $72 ÷ 6000 = $0.012 per gram, not $72 per gram.

expectations.text: The check has observable fields and expected values, with correction before Post and a warning that blank cost becomes zero.
expectations.evidence: Entry instructions identify Quantity and Cost with expected values 6000 and $0.012; step 3 says check both fields, correct either directly before Post, and warns blank cost is stored as zero.

expectations.text: After posting, it uses the History receipt ID and inventory lead for audited correction; it invents neither an undo nor a cost-unit selector.
expectations.evidence: Names Items > select item > History and its receipt ID, directs errors to inventory lead for audited correction, and explicitly says receipts cannot be edited or undone and there is no cost-unit selector.
